verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a first-party, Snowflake-managed MCP server that lets AI agents securely retrieve account data without deploying separate infrastructure (snowflake-docs-14). It can serve Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, custom tools and SQL execution as tools (snowflake-docs-57), and a probe confirms the official MCP server docs page exists (snowflake-probe-3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of connecting an agent to the server.
